name: B747-8I
comment: Transcribed from the official Boeing 747-8I vector three-view ('Minor corrections 20 June 2010', DWG->DXF): scale calibrated from the drawing's own DIMENSION entities (250ft2in = 76.25m over 4.288729 units, cross-checked against the 68.4m span dim to 0.04%), nose datum x=0.2580 shared by the side and top views, ground at the main-gear contact.  DXF layer map: L2 side outline, L11 wing planform, L1 top fuselage, L21 h-stab, L32 fin, L3 face view.  The wing LE is the L11 polyline verbatim: root (3.24, 24.55) -> kink (21.03, 40.93) at slope 0.921 (42.5deg LE sweep — the earlier 0.77 came from misapplying the 37.5deg QUARTER-CHORD sweep to the LE), then the raked-tip curve to (34.26, 54.45).  Aircraft coords: nose +Z, y up, meters; ground sits at y=-5.7.

fuselage.comment: stations traced from the DXF L2 side outline + L1 top widths: hump crown 4.36 flat zn8-24 (1.05m over the 3.31 aft crown; the compiler narrows the upper lobe there automatically), belly eases -3.4..-3.6 through the wing, tailcone tip ~zn75.5 (the fin TE tip owns the 76.25m length datum).

decals.comment: window bands and door stations read off the drawing's detail layers (main deck y 0.06-0.42, upper deck y 2.72-3.06).

wing.comment: L11 planform vertices verbatim; TE from scanlines 39.2@3.3 .. 54.4@33.  Dihedral linear root -2.4 -> tip 1.55 (face view).  Flaps in two sections like the real wing (inboard / outboard, gap behind the inner engine at x11.9 where the hinge polyline also kinks at the span-12 wing section) so each hinges about its own local LE line.

sections.comment: synthetic buried root (first-segment slopes extrapolated inboard): at the real root's height (y=-2.4) the hull side sits at x~2.4, not the max half-width 3.25, so a loft starting at 3.24 floats off the body

hstab.comment: L21 top view: half-span grows 3.66@zn66 -> 11.01@zn72.9, tips run to the tailcone end; side view puts the root at y~0.4 rising to ~1.5.

sections.comment: synthetic buried root (colinear extrapolation): the tailcone narrows to w~0.6 under the stab, so the x=0.9 root floats there too

fin.comment: L32 side view: LE 4.11@zn61 -> 13.10@zn72 (dz/dy 1.22), tip chord zn72.3..76.3 = the aftmost point of the aircraft.

engines.comment: GEnx nacelles, 4 under-wing pods; DXF side outlines: inner fan cowl zn 27.2..30.2 y -4.62..-1.40, outer zn 35.8..38.8 y -3.53..-0.31; x centers 11.9 / 21.3 from the top view.

gear.comment: the drawing's real 5-post layout: nose wheel circle at zn7.75, wing gear x±5.5 zn35.9, body gear x±1.92 zn39.0 (top-view wheel circles).  retract: nose swings forward into the nose bay; both main bogies fold inboard (bank -90, the real wing-gear motion) with dx/dy/dz parking the wheels flat inside the belly (bottom -3.55) clear of the wing root underside (~-2.9) and of each other (BodyGear staggers aft).  {nose, mains} kept for the old 3-post schema fallback.
